approver: Mohammed Bangie / AUTHOR-01, project owner; supervisors to review
summary: Permit model development on existing source datasets and synthetic fixtures while the future supervisor-double-annotated manual gold remains unavailable. T13 calibration (n=24) is annotation-process material only. The future approximately 300-record adjudicated set is designated manual_protected_challenge_set and must not influence development. T29 protocol freeze precedes unlocking manual gold for T30 protected execution. Variant-aware analysis caching is required so full_context and context_blind can coexist per record.
rationale: Calendar time should not idle while supervisors annotate asynchronously. Source datasets carry verified labels for many metric families; synthetic fixtures support interface development without inventing gold. Separating development partitions from the delayed manual challenge set preserves T30 official-result integrity.
risk: Source-development tuning may overfit development partitions; T13 calibration or future manual gold must not leak into development; shared analysis caches without variant separation would leak scene context into context-blind ablation.
required_reruns: None; documentation and governance-log updates only.
protected_test_implications: Future manual_protected_challenge_set remains inaccessible until T29 protocol freeze and T30 authorised execution. T13 calibration records are excluded from protected evaluation.

summary: Replace failed one-call full-schema generation with task-conditioned partial-schema prediction plus deterministic StructuredAnalysis assembly. One shared adapter; T27/T27B evidence retained; T28 blocked until T27C passes.
rationale: T27 job 6059 and T27B job 6382 both failed full-envelope emission (0 accepted). Increasing structural supervision did not yield reliable full output. Smaller task schemas with deterministic routing/assembly preserve safety and provenance.
risk: Task decomposition gaps; constrained-decoding unavailability must fail closed.
required_reruns: One live qlora_task_conditioned_smoke; one technical-defect rerun permitted.
protected_test_implications: No holdout/T13/manual/protected/model-selection leakage; selected_adapter and selected_model_strategy remain null.
